context:
Goal: batch 81 lands today without wasted CI.
Problem (rule): GitHub's internal error ended run 43088666860 before its two gate jobs ran, and the page offers only "Re-run all jobs". Your rule never to merge failing CI means the gate must go green.
Based on (measured): 19 jobs passed and 33 were skipped. The two gate jobs, all-jobs-passed and ci-done, never got a runner.
Based on (measured): the run's menu has no cancel and no "Re-run failed jobs".
Departs from: main, where a batch merges only on a green all-jobs-passed — option b merges on the 19 passed jobs without it.
Meanwhile: the batch runner waits; batches 82 and 83 queue behind 81.
holds: Whether the batch runner may cancel and re-run the two stuck macOS jobs of run 43088666860, once.
home: ruling R26 (no self-made reruns), exception for this run only

options.gain: A real green gate, with no rule bent.
options.how: On the run's page, press "Re-run all jobs" once.
options.label: Re-run all jobs once (Recommended)
options.lose: One more full CI run, about 50 minutes by today's run.

options.how: Merge batch 81 on the 19 passed jobs, by your named act.
options.label: Merge on the passed jobs
options.lose: The gate never ran, and branch protection makes it an admin bypass.

title: Batch 81: re-run all jobs once, or merge on the 19 passed jobs?
why: Batch 81 holds the Windows time-limit fix you want in before the archive. A GitHub fault ended its run before the two gate jobs ran.
